tasks.subject: Task 1: Rule Deduplication
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prevent duplicate `category_rules` from repeated user decisions; deduplicate existing rules.

**Files:**
- Modify: `apps/api/src/db.ts`
- Modify: `apps/api/src/rules.ts`
- Modify: `apps/api/tests/rules.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `upsertDecision` twice with same counterparty+category creates exactly 1 rule
- [ ] Same counterparty with different categories creates 2 rules
- [ ] Existing duplicate rules removed on startup via migration
- [ ] All existing tests pass

**Verify:** `cd apps/api && NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-sqlite tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/rules.test.ts` → all pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps/api/src/db.ts", "apps/api/src/rules.ts", "apps/api/tests/rules.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "cd apps/api && NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-sqlite tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/rules.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no duplicate rules from repeated decisions", "different categories create separate rules", "migration deduplicates existing rules"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: AI Rule Suggestion Backend
tasks.description:
**Goal:** New `ruleSuggestions.ts` generates AI suggestions for uncategorized transactions; REST endpoints to list/accept/reject.

**Files:**
- Modify: `apps/api/src/db.ts` (rule_suggestions table)
- Create: `apps/api/src/ruleSuggestions.ts`
- Create: `apps/api/tests/rule-suggestions.test.ts`
- Modify: `apps/api/src/importer.ts`
- Modify: `apps/api/src/index.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `rule_suggestions` table created
- [ ] `listPendingRuleSuggestions()` returns pending only
- [ ] `acceptRuleSuggestion(id)` creates rule + applies to existing Muut transactions
- [ ] `acceptRuleSuggestion(id)` skips duplicate rules
- [ ] `rejectRuleSuggestion(id)` marks rejected without creating rule
- [ ] `generateRuleSuggestions()` is no-op without OpenAI key
- [ ] 3 REST endpoints added

**Verify:** `cd apps/api && NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-sqlite tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/rule-suggestions.test.ts` → 4/4 pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps/api/src/db.ts", "apps/api/src/ruleSuggestions.ts", "apps/api/src/importer.ts", "apps/api/src/index.ts", "apps/api/tests/rule-suggestions.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "cd apps/api && NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-sqlite tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/rule-suggestions.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["rule_suggestions table exists", "list/accept/reject functions work", "accept creates rule and applies retroactively", "no-op without API key"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: AI Rule Suggestions UI
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `RuleSuggestionsPanel` shows pending AI rule suggestions with one-click approve/reject.

**Files:**
- Modify: `apps/web/src/api/client.ts`
- Create: `apps/web/src/components/RuleSuggestionsPanel.tsx`
- Modify: `apps/web/src/views/HomeView.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] RuleSuggestionsPanel loads suggestions on mount and on refreshKey change
- [ ] Each row shows: counterparty → category + AI reason
- [ ] Approve button calls accept, removes row optimistically
- [ ] Reject button calls reject, removes row optimistically
- [ ] Panel hidden when no pending suggestions
- [ ] Mounted in HomeView after BriefingPanel with briefingRefreshKey

